audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart gives Irelia all 7 stages while content win[] gives Mel all 7 — the page argues with itself, and the whys all describe Mel winning.
audit.why: Mel (ranged, Rebuttal reflect vs Irelia's projectile E/R) genuinely wins early stages; Irelia's 46.36% deficit for Mel and HARD rating come from her level 6 + item all-in, Q resets and Q sustain.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-4 (Levels 1 through 4-5) to Mel on both layers; rows 5-7 (Level 6, First item, 2+ items) to Irelia on both layers, whys rewritten to match.

audit.why: Spikes are real: Mel W level 2, snare-volley at 3, Golden Eclipse at 6, Luden's; Irelia spikes 6 + first item — now reflected in the chart flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; enemyWin was a name-swap template; the Vanguard's Edge retreat-cutting wall and Bladesurge sustain (anti-heal) were unmentioned.
audit.why: Irelia E is 16s rank 1 (her only hard CC and a projectile Mel's W can reflect), W gives physical damage reduction during charge, Q heals and resets on Marked/killing targets, R is 125s and leaves a slowing wall of terrain-like disengage denial.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with 16s/38s/125s; enemyWin grounded in Duet + Q resets + Q sustain; R-wall Flash advice folded into cooldowns; anti-heal already present in report[8].
